ROM_OWNERSHIP.required: Exclusive runtime ownership of exact [E1000,E1364), including indirect readers, vectors/checksum and boot paths.

RAM_OWNERSHIP.required: Exclusive lifetime ownership of [FFFF7400,FFFF7420), including indirect/bulk/DMA accesses; reset DMA is known to cross it.

TASK_STACK_TIMING.required: Task9/6580 ->11134 ->1193A stack/ISR nesting and reentrancy/cadence budget; added124-byte frame and instruction counts alone do not prove headroom.

CURRENT_CALIBRATION.required: Human-confirmed currently flashed read-back identity and compatibility review for actual VF52/3-port/3-inch MAF hardware. Known local filenames do not establish current installation.

PHYSICAL_TEST_CANDIDATE.required: Review one precisely hashed candidate after all engineering prerequisites close.

VEHICLE_VALIDATED.required: Human-controlled testing and measured results; none invented here.
